caption_L1: This is a bar plot named Leading reasons for disliking wrapping Christmas presents in the United Kingdom (UK) in 2015. On the x-axis, Response is shown with a categorical scale with Always forget something i.e. wrapping paper, labels, tape etc. on one end and Wrapping paper is too expensive at the other. The y-axis shows Share of respondents along a linear scale from 0.0 to 0.5.
caption_L2L3: The main reason people surveyed disliked wrapping presents was because it takes too much time. The second highest reason was that they always forget something. Some of the answers on the response axis have been cut short.
